task:
FIX THREE REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #800 (archetype calibration probe). Target branch codex/run-38014383389-1, expected head 551550e; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_probe.py, tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe.py, scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-calibration-probe.sh, tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe_operator.py and .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml may change.

F1 (P1, job timeout): the probe may run 1,500 s but the `execute` job in .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml has timeout-minutes: 10, so the job would be cancelled before the receipt prints. FIX: give the probe step its own budget without changing the job default for every other operation: add `timeout-minutes: 35` on the 'Stage trusted main and run V3 archetype calibration probe' step AND raise the job's `timeout-minutes` to 40 ONLY IF a step-level timeout cannot exceed the job-level one (it cannot — a job timeout cancels steps), so set the job-level timeout-minutes to 40 and add a comment that the probe step is the reason; keep every other step unchanged. Assert both values in tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe_operator.py; also check whether any existing test pins `timeout-minutes: 10` for this workflow (grep tests/) and update it to the new contract rather than deleting the assertion.

F2 (P2, installer output in receipt): pip install prints to stdout inside the container and that stdout is the probe output file, so probe_json is not valid JSON. FIX: in the container command redirect the pip install's stdout to stderr (`... pip install ... 1>&2`) and pass --quiet, so only the probe process writes to stdout; in the action, after the run, validate the captured output with `"$PYTHON_BIN" -c 'import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))' "$output_file"` and, on failure, print result=failed and exit_code=65 (invalid_probe_output) while still printing the raw output under probe_output_raw= for diagnosis. Test: stub docker emits a non-JSON line before the JSON -> result=failed; stub emits only JSON -> result=completed and probe_json= is followed by exactly that JSON.

F3 (P2, empty sample): when --max-systems is smaller than every chunk, select_chunk_ordinals returns [] and the probe exits 0 with systems_sampled 0. FIX: in _run, if no ordinals are selected OR aggregate.systems == 0, print 'calibration sample is empty: raise --max-systems (at least one full chunk must fit)' to stderr and return exit code 5; document exit code 5 in the module docstring. Tests: --max-systems 1 against the fixture generation returns 5 (PostgreSQL test, skips without the fixture) and a unit test for select_chunk_ordinals returning [] when max_systems < smallest chunk.

VALIDATION (paste commands and counts): 1. ruff check on the Python files  2. bash -n the action  3. python -m pytest tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe.py tests/test_v3_archetype_calibration_probe_operator.py tests/test_v3_system_search_validate_constraints.py tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py -q -p no:cacheprovider (PostgreSQL tests skip on the runner; say so)  4. yaml.safe_load of the ops workflow  5. git diff --name-only 551550e lists only the allowed files. Commit message: 'feat(finder): calibration probe — job budget, JSON-only receipt, reject empty samples'.
